title: Picking a lock prompts a Dexterity (thieves' tools) roll from the player

llm_context.canon: Table rule: players roll their own dice. The iron-bound chest is locked; picking it needs a Dexterity check with thieves' tools, which Aria has.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I take out my thieves' tools and try to pick the chest's lock.

actions.text: The lock is old but well-made — rust flakes from the keyhole as you seat the tension wrench and lift a pick.

actions.question: Roll Dexterity (thieves' tools) to pick the lock.
